name: research-setup
description: Set up a research repository several people and their Claudes can share without tripping over each other: per-author folders, portable paths derived rather than configured, one canonical dataset with recorded promotion, provenance read out of the code, a git-enforced round lock, and a generated CLAUDE.md that makes the whole thing self-explaining. Optional two-build (analyst/replicator) protocol for empirical work, an OpenRouter debate panel, and an Overleaf mirror of the paper directory via the git bridge for teams where only some coauthors use Overleaf. Works on a new project or an existing one that grew organically.
